GateResult Class

Source: R/GateResult.R
GateResult.Rd

Result object returned by a diagnostic gate (G1–G7).

A GateResult contains a standardized status (pass, warn, fail, skip, error), a short natural-language summary, optional numeric metrics, and optional artifacts (tables and intermediate objects) used for reproducibility and plotting.

Format

R6::R6Class object.

Compatibility status

GateResult is retained only for the legacy AutoIML compatibility workflow. Its heuristic pass, warn, fail, and skip labels are not CSDG evidence roles or claim decisions. New analyses should use csdg_audit(), csdg_evidence_record(), and csdg_adjudicate_claim().

Fields

  • gate_id :: character(1)
    Short gate identifier, e.g. "G2".

  • gate_name :: character(1)
    Human-readable gate name.

  • pdr :: character(1)
    Stage label used by the framework (e.g. "P", "D", "R").

  • status :: character(1)
    One of pass, warn, fail, skip, error.

  • summary :: character(1)
    Short summary of what was found and the implied recommendations.

  • metrics :: data.table::data.table | NULL
    Optional gate-specific numeric metrics.

  • artifacts :: list() | NULL
    Optional gate-specific artifacts (tables, models, etc.).

  • messages :: character() | NULL
    Optional additional messages and caveats.
